pages.text: $(thing)Follow$(): walks with you and fights what threatens you. If they fall more than 13 blocks behind, they teleport to your side, even across dimensions or from unloaded chunks.$(br2)$(thing)Guard$(): defends the spot where you set the stance, staying within about 6 blocks of it.

$(thing)Stay$(): stands still and does not hunt or chase anything. They still defend themselves if attacked.$(br2)Companions in $(thing)Guard$() or $(thing)Stay$() never teleport to you. Use the $(l:epicvanguard:reference/commands)call command$() to bring them back.
